_how_to_use: One block per week. A link set to null shows the step as Not posted yet. extras are the second links listed under a step in the step list. A week whose steps all have pages is drawn as the straight line: each step shows what (one line) and its pages [{label, href or null, desc, optional}]; empty is the text for a step with no pages; loop draws the way back after that step; title, sub, time and badges override the defaults. Run: python3 tools/build_week_entry.py 4
